# Sports artwork

The two runtime sprites come from the project owner's purchased **Modern Exteriors by LimeZu** pack, `Modern_Exteriors_16x16/ME_Theme_Sorter_16x16/13_School_Singles_16x16/`:

- `soccer.png`: `ME_Singles_School_16x16_Soccer_Court_1.png`
- `basketball.png`: `ME_Singles_School_16x16_Basketball_Court_1.png`

Credit: https://limezu.itch.io/modernexteriors. Used as part of this game, subject to the pack's license; not relicensed as open-source artwork or offered as an asset download. The full purchased ZIP is not included.
